path_findings.finding: New task-private additive windows proposed, although historical task card says no proposed new paths; coordinator must explicitly register accurate window before source edits.
Legacy writers touch the same native Outbox/DLQ rows that V2 companion protects; additive folder alone cannot prove no V1 bypass.
Read-only dependency; no change needed. Existing seven-key/no-prior-advisory-lock profile cannot be stretched to an Outbox root or nested unchanged.

risk_findings.finding: V1 bypass of V2-bound native rows including legacy Requeue and broad DLQ retention
risk_findings.test: Race/attempt each legacy Claim, MarkPublished, MarkFailed, Requeue and DeleteExpired against a V2-bound row; no protected mutation/deletion. Gate failure never falls back to V1.

risk_findings.finding: Legacy byte[] IsRowVersion is not evidence of PostgreSQL native concurrency
risk_findings.test: Versioned opt-in native PG adapter reads actual post-write native xmin/generated token and Binding token from database; forged/stale/pre-write tokens fail. Preserve original table keys/DTO byte semantics and freeze opaque codec.

risk_findings.finding: Success transport then local failure falsely counted as publish failure
risk_findings.test: Inject faults before publish, after broker acceptance, before commit and after real committed mutation response lost; no MarkFailed/newmutation/newbusiness-key on Unknown. Missing receipt remains Unknown.

risk_findings.finding: Stale epoch/token/expiry or root switch can authorize old worker
risk_findings.test: DB-clock gate before/equal/after expiry; forged worker/root/tenant/message/hash; stale native and Binding RV; both orderings of completion vs drain/advance; renewal vs completion; immutable replay after epoch change zero extra writes.

risk_findings.finding: Hold/Unknown/consumer obligations/reference closure can be destroyed by age cleanup
risk_findings.test: Hold-first deletion rejected; cleanup-first later replay reports EVIDENCE_EXPIRED with original result readable. Retain absent-policy/unknown/conflict/unresolvedreceipt/dedup-needed rows; arbitrary IDs and cross-tenant candidates rejected; whole transaction rollback on audit failure.

risk_findings.finding: Fake transaction/registered proof/worker clock can replace actual native boundary
risk_findings.test: Reject different connection/transaction, ended handle, ambient/provider mismatch and substituted trusted context; native locks held through commit; no network under locks; actual same-DB business+native+binding+receipt rollback.

risk_findings.finding: PG xmin is transaction-scoped; post-write receipt cannot legitimize subsequent same-transaction mutation
risk_findings.test: Read DB-generated tokens only after final claim/renew native+binding write; enforce no later native/binding edits before commit; immutable ticket and bytes; never refresh stale ticket from latest row. Epoch and unique claim IDs remain independent guards.

risk_findings.finding: Synthetic fixtures overclaim Original60AC, actual transport or host adoption
risk_findings.test: Keep execution-kind/syntheticOwner/fault-injection labels plus source/dependency/artifact hashes, TRX/failures, exact mapping and explicit NOT_RUN Owner cells.
